extraction_notes: Verified the supplied PDF SHA-256 is 7a62f57e03a697d69fe4da72fb546954b92f619340a01fac1029258f15679a85.
The supplied datasheet identifies AP2003 as an ALLPOWER N and P-channel power MOSFET and shows revision v1.0 in the page footers.

This schema has one polarity field. The extraction uses the N-channel section, which is the first channel presented in the supplied datasheet; the datasheet's separate P-channel table and plots are not merged into the N-channel numeric fields.
N-channel voltage and current values are represented with positive numeric magnitudes and the printed bias directions are retained in conditions strings.

Figures 5, 7, 9, 10, 11, and 12 contain usable N-channel plotted traces. Listed points are compact direct readings from the raster plots and are not interpolated; traces or regions clipped by plot bounds were not extended.

The strict MOSFET schema has no fields for IDSS, gate leakage, forward transconductance, switching times, gate charge table values, thermal ratings, package data, or absolute maximum ratings, so those fields were not added outside schema.
